name: Dragonfly
author: TH3N3WN00B@users.noreply.github.com
description: Dragonfly is an in-memory data store built for modern application workloads. It is fully compatible with Redis and Memcached APIs and requires no code changes to adopt.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Dragonfly Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Import data from a Redis server: Dragonfly loads dump.rdb on start while it has no snapshot of its own.
if [ -f dump.rdb ] && [ ! -f dump-summary.dfs ]; then
    SRC_VER=$(head -c 128 dump.rdb | tr -c ' -~' ' ' | sed -n 's/.*redis-ver *\([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p')
    SRC_VER=${SRC_VER:-unknown}
    if ! ls -d backups/*-redis-"${SRC_VER}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        BACKUP="backups/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-redis-${SRC_VER}"
        mkdir -p "${BACKUP}"
        cp -p dump.rdb "${BACKUP}/"
        echo -e "Backed up the data written by Redis ${SRC_VER} to ${BACKUP}. Dragonfly imports it on the next start."
    fi
fi

ARCH=$([[ "$(uname -m)" == "x86_64" ]] && echo "x86_64" || echo "aarch64")

if [ -z "${DF_VERSION}" ] || [ "${DF_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/releases/latest/download/dragonfly-${ARCH}.tar.gz"
else
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/releases/download/v${DF_VERSION#v}/dragonfly-${ARCH}.tar.gz"
fi

echo -e "Downloading ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
if ! curl -fsSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o dragonfly.tar.gz; then
    rm -f dragonfly.tar.gz
    echo -e "Failed to download Dragonfly ${DF_VERSION}"
    exit 1
fi

tar -xzf dragonfly.tar.gz "dragonfly-${ARCH}"
mv -f "dragonfly-${ARCH}" dragonfly
chmod +x dragonfly
rm -f dragonfly.tar.gz

echo -e "Install complete. Dragonfly ${DF_VERSION} (${ARCH}) installed."

variables.name: Dragonfly Password
variables.description: The password Dragonfly should use to secure the server.

variables.name: Dragonfly Version
variables.description: The Dragonfly release to install, for example 2.0.2, or latest for the newest release. Reinstall the server to apply a change.

variables.name: Threads
variables.description: Number of Dragonfly threads. Each thread needs at least 256 MB of memory. 0 uses every CPU core of the host.

variables.name: Snapshot Schedule
variables.description: Cron expression for periodic snapshots to disk, for example */5 * * * * for every 5 minutes. Leave empty to only save on shutdown.
